# GUI Interface Description

## System Header Bar
- **Left Side**: "Activities" button
- **Center**: "Settings" title
- **Right Side**: 
  - Date and time: "Oct 23 01:07"
  - Notification bell icon
  - System status icons (network, sound, power)

## Desktop Environment
- **Background**: Gradient wallpaper transitioning from dark purple to red-orange
- **Left Dock**: Vertical application launcher with icons for:
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP
  - Files (file manager)
  - Ubuntu Software
  - Help (question mark)
  - Settings (gear icon, currently active)
  - Trash
  - App grid (9-dot icon at bottom)
- **Bottom Right Corner**: "Home" folder icon with label

## Settings Window
- **Title Bar**: "Settings" with search icon on left and hamburger menu icon on right
- **Window Controls**: Minimize, maximize, close buttons on top right
- **Main Content Area**: "Online Accounts" section with heading "Connect to your data in the cloud"

## Left Sidebar Navigation
- **Categories** (with icons and labels):
  - Network
  - Bluetooth
  - Background
  - Appearance
  - Notifications
  - Search
  - Multitasking
  - Applications (with right-pointing arrow)
  - Privacy (with right-pointing arrow)
  - Online Accounts (highlighted in orange, currently selected)
  - Sharing
  - Sound
  - Power
  - Displays
  - Mouse & Touchpad
  - Keyboard
  - Printers

## Online Accounts Content Area
- **Main Heading**: "Connect to your data in the cloud"
- **Add an account section**:
  - **Ubuntu Single Sign-On** (with Ubuntu logo)
  - **Microsoft Exchange** (with Microsoft Exchange logo)
  - **IMAP and SMTP** (with envelope icon)
  - **Enterprise Login (Kerberos)** (with key icon)

## Ubuntu Single Sign-On Account Dialog
- **Title**: "Ubuntu Single Sign-On Account"
- **Action Buttons**:
  - "Cancel" (left)
  - "Connect" (right)
- **Form Fields**:
  - **Email address**: Text input field with orange border, currently empty
  - **Password**: Text input field, currently empty
- **Radio Buttons**:
  - "I have an Ubuntu Single Sign-On account" (selected, with orange radio button)
  - "I want to register for an account now" (unselected)
  - "I've forgotten my password" (unselected)
- **Link**: "Privacy Policy" (red text, underlined) at bottom right of dialog
